column2: The climate of Chattogram, the second largest city in Bangladesh, is tropical, influenced

column1: by the monsoon, with a dry
column4: from November to March and a rainy season from May to October. The

column1: city is in southeastern Bangladesh, at 22 degrees north latitude, on the coast of the Bay of Bengal. Since
the coast is exposed to the southwest, it directly receives the humid currents brought by the monsoon, in
fact, the rains are very abundant, especially from June to August.
